---
applyTo: "docs/analysis/**"
description: Rules for the legacy-code analysis knowledge base
---

Follow `.claude/skills/legacy-code-analysis/SKILL.md`.

- Script-generated files (`inventory.*`, `callgraph.mmd`, `crud-matrix.md`, `data-dictionary.md`, `screens.md`, `batch-flows.md`,
  `domains.md`, `programs/*.md`, `target-mapping.md`, `data-mapping.md`) are regenerated by the scripts. Don't hand-edit them.
- Hand-written files are `system-overview.md`, `rules/<domain>.md`, `findings.md` and `analysis-notes.md`.
- Business rules are written in business language, with Type, Confidence and `Validation status: Candidate` and a source link to the lines.
- Never paste source code. Cite `path:line` and run
  `docver.py linkify docs/analysis --context docs/requirements/PROJECT-CONTEXT.md`.
